principles: Retries are bounded recovery attempts, never an infinite loop.
Cancellation suppresses all future retries immediately once requested.
A dead-letter item must have one accountable owner and retained evidence.
Unknown external outcomes fail closed to human review and are never automatically retried.
Dead-letter requeue requires explicit approval and the original idempotency boundary.
openDeadLetterRules: OPEN items may not be silently deleted or auto-requeued.
Owner reassignment must be retained as evidence.
cancellationRules: REQUESTED, ACKNOWLEDGED and CANCELLED all block creation of new retry attempts.
Cancellation cannot claim an in-flight external action was reversed unless the external outcome is positively known.
An unknown in-flight external outcome becomes human review, not replay.
Cancellation evidence must identify requester, request time and cancellation reference.
requeueRules: Only OPEN or RESOLVED dead-letter work may be considered for requeue according to policy; REJECTED work is terminal.
Requeue requires approvalRef, owner, idempotencyKey and evidenceRef.
A cancelled subject may not be requeued until a separate owner-authorized resume decision exists.
External work with unknown outcome may not be requeued automatically.
